summary: The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by obtaining short exposure to investment returns of the broad U.S. large-capitalization equity market through short sales of U.S.-traded equity securities and ETFs. Under normal circumstances, it invests at least 80% of its net assets in investments that create or result in short exposure to U.S. equity securities.
